text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle governing the relative subject and setting the whole promise inside an affirmed frame
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens by putting the whole statement into an asserted frame. It governs the relative subject and holds the later future promise inside settled declaration, so the affection outcome is heard as confirmed news rather than tentative expectation. Its doubled sound gives that certainty a compact audible start and treats the qualifying class as already established.

topics.headline: assertion and governance frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word governs the relative subject and holds the whole promise inside an asserted frame.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence confirm an emphatic governing particle whose predicate is the later promise clause.

topics.headline: emphatic force and presupposed class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the assertion as more than decoration: it confirms the promise while treating the described class as established.
topics.reason: The semantic and form rows preserve emphatic force and audible doubling without changing the particle parse.

topics.headline: opening declaration at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah open in settled declaration mode at the surah close, so the affection promise is not introduced as speculation.
topics.reason: The structural rows concern scope, discourse launch, and sound linkage; they fit the local assertion frame.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun defining an open group through the following belief-and-deed clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) creates a plural class defined by the clause that follows. The group is not named by lineage or social label; it is built by the two coordinated qualifying acts. Against the universal aloneness of 19:95, this word begins the narrowed group that receives the promise in 19:96.

topics.headline: relative subject element
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a governed relative pronoun whose content must be supplied by the following clause.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the pronoun as the subject element governed by the opening particle.

topics.headline: open class membership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is not named by lineage or social label but by qualifying actions.
topics.reason: The form and semantic rows support an open plural class whose boundaries come from the relative clause.

topics.headline: one qualified group after 19:95
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 19:96 narrow from the universal aloneness of 19:95 to a condition-defined group.
topics.reason: The boundary and clause-building rows are retained as discourse payoff, not as a new lexical sense for the pronoun.

words.gloss_range: completed plural Form IV believing and trusting, with no stated object in this clause
words.root_gloss_range: faith, trust, security, and reliability; locally narrowed to active believing and trusting rather than mere safety
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) supplies the first completed act that defines the relative class. Its objectless Form IV wording presents a broad believing-trusting orientation, while {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) keeps trust, reliability, and security as supporting pressure rather than replacing the local faith sense. The verb also joins a familiar belief-and-deed formula: 19:60 and 19:63 use the same pattern within the surah, 18:30 moves it toward reward, and judgment-making contrasts such as 38:28 sharpen how 19:96 turns the class toward affection.

topics.headline: completed plural faith-act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith as a completed collective qualification belonging to the whole relative class.
topics.reason: The perfect 3mp form agrees with the relative head and sits inside the subject clause.

topics.headline: trust and security pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears faith with trust, reliability, and security overtones, while the local Form IV formula keeps believing as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root has no V4 guardrail rows, so the CRITICAL semantic range is preserved but narrowed by the local verb form and formula.

topics.headline: belief-and-deed formula links
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the familiar belief-and-deed formula, with same-surah reward links at 19:60 and 19:63 and wider contrasts at 18:30, 38:28, and 45:30.
topics.reason: The concrete formula references are useful comparison evidence, while local syntax keeps the verb inside the relative subject clause.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the two qualifying verbs inside one relative clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the faith verb and the work verb inside one relative clause. It makes the two acts coordinated criteria rather than alternatives or a new sentence, while still keeping inward faith and outward action distinct. The attached continuation makes the second act visibly enter as part of the same qualification.

topics.headline: coordinated criteria
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two verbs as coordinated criteria inside one relative clause, not alternatives or a new sentence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second verb as conjoined with the first inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: togetherness without collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices inward faith and outward action bound together while remaining distinct.
topics.reason: The conjunction’s coordination is primary, and its accompaniment pressure supports the paired ethical profile.

topics.headline: attached inner-outer pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the joined verbs as the Quranic inner-and-outer ethical formula.
topics.reason: The structural and sound rows preserve the linked-but-distinct payoff without altering the coordination parse.

words.gloss_range: completed plural performance of deeds with an explicit righteous-deeds object
words.root_gloss_range: intentional doing, work, and productive action; locally narrowed to ethical performance rather than instrumental use, wages, office, or road imagery
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) makes the group active performers of the deed-object. {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) adds purposive work and productive agency to the formula, but the explicit object keeps the sense in ethical performance rather than instrumental use or official assignment. The verb is the hinge between faith on the left and sound deeds on the right; the same formula receives garden or reward language at 19:60, 19:63, and 42:23, while 19:96 turns the divine response toward affection.

topics.headline: performed deed-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that righteousness is the thing performed, not merely an adjective attached to the subjects.
topics.reason: Attachment and verb-instance evidence mark an explicit direct object after the work verb.

topics.headline: purposive productive work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears directed work and productive agency in the verb, while the explicit object keeps it in ethical performance.
topics.reason: V4 supports intentional doing as the relevant branch; other work-family branches are not selected locally.

topics.headline: formula hinge and reward contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the work verb as the hinge between faith and sound deeds, with reward contrasts at 19:60, 19:63, 42:23, 18:2, and 10:81.
topics.reason: The formula and contrast rows are concrete and relevant, but they remain comparison evidence under the local verb-object grammar.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active-participle noun functioning as the performed deed-object
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, rightness, repair, reconciliation, and fitness; locally narrowed to the recognized category of righteous deeds
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) closes the subject clause as the definite plural object of the work verb. {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) gives the deeds a field of soundness, repair, fitness, and anti-corruption, while the local form makes that field a recognized category of performed acts. The divine predicate begins only after this ethical profile has landed, and the same righteous-deed category carries reward and care contrasts at 19:60, 7:196, and 21:72.

topics.headline: definite plural object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognized category of sound acts as the object of performance.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a definite plural active-participle noun serving as direct object.

topics.headline: soundness and repair field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears righteous deeds as acts of soundness, repair, fitness, and anti-corruption, not only generic good deeds.
topics.reason: V4 supports soundness, repair, reconciliation, and fitness; the local plural object blocks proper-name and place-name branches.

topics.headline: formula completion before promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the subject clause land on the deed-object before the divine predicate opens, with formula links at 19:60, 7:196, and 21:72.
topics.reason: The references and placement rows support formula completion and reward contrast, while local role evidence keeps the object reading.

words.gloss_range: assured future making or placing with beneficiaries and an affection object
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, rendering, and configuring; locally narrowed to relational placement of affection, not bare creation from nothing or unrelated nominal branches
words.prose: {{ar:سَيَجْعَلُ}} ({{tr:sa-yajʿalu}}) starts the predicate promise with an assured future act, and its singular form already anticipates the delayed divine agent. {{ar:ج ع ل}} ({{tr:j-ʿ-l}}) selects placing or configuring affection for beneficiaries, not an unrelated making branch or bare creation from nothing. The verb frame holds recipient and object together; making-affection parallels at 60:7 and 30:21 show the same field, while the boundary from 19:95 to 19:96 turns approach toward God into divine bestowal for the qualified group.

topics.headline: assured future verb frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a future act that is already held inside certainty, with beneficiaries and object built into the frame.
topics.reason: QAC, attachment, and verb-instance evidence confirm future-marked imperfect grammar with beneficiary and direct-object complements.

topics.headline: relational placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines affection being placed or configured for recipients, while bare creation from nothing and unrelated making branches are not active.
topics.reason: V4 supports making and rendering branches; the local beneficiary plus affection object narrows the verb to relational configuration.

topics.headline: bestowal after 19:95
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the movement from creatures approaching God in 19:95 turn into God acting for the qualified group in 19:96, with making-affection parallels at 60:7, 30:21, 28:73, 19:21, and 19:7.
topics.reason: The delayed-agent and cross-reference rows are preserved as discourse payoff, with overbroad word-order claims narrowed by ordinary Arabic verbal order.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition marking benefit, direction, and recipient relation in the beneficiary phrase
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) routes the promise toward the beneficiaries. It prevents the group from being read as the thing made; affection is the object, while the bound preposition marks benefit, direction, and assigned relation for them. Its position before the named agent lets the promise land on the recipients first.

topics.headline: beneficiary routing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids making the believers the direct object; they are the recipients for whom affection is placed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the pronoun as governed by the preposition while the affection word is the direct object.

topics.headline: benefit direction and assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the affection as directed to them, beneficially assigned to them, and placed on their side of the relation.
topics.reason: The semantic rows on the preposition fit the local beneficiary phrase.

topics.headline: recipient before named giver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters the recipients before the divine agent is named, so the promise first lands on the qualified group.
topics.reason: The bound preposition-pronoun form and local word order support the foregrounded-recipient payoff.

words.gloss_range: attached plural pronoun carrying the previously defined group into the beneficiary slot
words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) carries the already-defined belief-and-deed group into the beneficiary phrase. The pronoun is governed by the preposition, not introduced as a new subject, so the same class moves from description into recipienthood. The plural reference narrows the universal scope of 19:95 into the qualified recipients of 19:96.

topics.headline: prepositional pronoun object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun as governed by the preposition, not as a new independent subject.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the pronoun in the beneficiary prepositional slot.

topics.headline: compact carried antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole belief-and-deed class is carried forward without repeating the long subject phrase.
topics.reason: The attached plural suffix preserves reference to the relative-clause group.

topics.headline: qualified them after 19:95
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the plural reference narrow from all in 19:95 to the qualified recipients in 19:96.
topics.reason: The boundary and order rows are anchored in the pronoun’s local beneficiary role.

words.gloss_range: definite divine compassion-name as the nominative agent of the making act
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, tenderness, nurturing care, and the divine compassion-name; locally the named agent whose mercy field fits the affection object
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ}} ({{tr:al-Raḥmānu}}) is the delayed nominative agent of the making act. {{ar:ر ح م}} ({{tr:r-ḥ-m}}) makes mercy, tenderness, and womb-care imagery integral to the promise: the compassion-name stands between beneficiaries and the final affection object. The word gathers a Surah 19 mercy thread from 19:2 into a closing act of love, and wider making-affection links are recast here as the act of the Compassionate rather than an impersonal social result.

topics.headline: definite nominative agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Compassionate as the grammatical agent of placing affection, not as a modifier of the recipients.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a definite nominative divine name as subject of the making verb.

topics.headline: mercy-name fits affection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears mercy, tenderness, and nurturing care in the agent name, while local grammar keeps it as the divine subject.
topics.reason: V4 supports mercy, tenderness, kinship, and womb-related pressure; the local divine-name form selects compassionate agency.

topics.headline: mercy thread becomes love agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the compassion-name stand between beneficiaries and affection, gathering the Surah 19 mercy thread from 19:2 and contrasts at 19:45 and 20:90 into the promise of 19:96.
topics.reason: The structural, sound, boundary, and intertext rows converge on delayed named agency rather than a separate lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative gerund naming steady affection as the object placed for the group
words.root_gloss_range: affection, loving attachment, friendship, and wishing; locally the affection branch is selected over place-name, idol-name, peg, or bare wishing branches
words.prose: {{ar:وُدًّۭا}} ({{tr:wuddan}}) is the indefinite accusative gerund that completes the promise. {{ar:و د د}} ({{tr:w-d-d}}) selects steady relational affection and warm attachment, not merely private passion, a place-name branch, or an idol-name branch; variant vowels keep the object slot as affection while testing noun-like and verb-like weight. As the final word, it answers the solitude of 19:95 with relation, changes affection-root direction from scenes such as 30:21, 60:7, 11:90, 85:14, 5:82, and 42:23, and turns the assertion of 19:96 into a guaranteed landing on love.

topics.headline: indefinite affection object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees affection itself as the thing placed, left qualitatively open rather than defined as one familiar instance.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark an indefinite accusative gerund as the direct object.

topics.headline: steady relational affection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears steady communal warmth and loving attachment, while variants and root-family pressure stay within the affection branch.
topics.reason: V4 selects affection and loving attachment locally; qiraat vowels show form pressure without shifting to place-name, idol-name, peg, or bare wishing branches.

topics.headline: final love after aloneness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word answer the solitude of 19:95 with relation in 19:96, while affection-root links at 30:21, 60:7, 11:90, 85:14, 5:82, and 42:23 show changed direction and certainty.
topics.reason: The closure, boundary, rarity, and cross-reference rows are retained as payoff, but the local object grammar controls the sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 3-9 moves from believing and doing reparative deeds through the Compassionate's future making to wudd.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled assent becomes intentional anti-corruptive practice; the Compassionate then renders its social result as an actual condition of affection.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inwardly trusted starting state.
Intentional action carries the inward state into chosen practice.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives the practice a reparative direction.
Rendering something into a condition supplies the transition from practice to social state.
Tender mercy and beneficence characterize the agent of the transformation.
Love and mutual affection name the resulting social condition.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good receive a general promise of being loved.
changed_reading.after: Secure assent becomes intentional repair, and the Compassionate converts that repaired practice into a conferred social condition of affection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of عملوا الصالحات, سيجعل, and ودا at words 4-9 permits a specifically interpersonal mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human dealings that remove estrangement are not merely classified as good; they are made to settle into reciprocal affection.

activation_trace.role: Dealings between people supply the interpersonal site of the acts.
Reconciliation that removes mutual aversion supplies the acts' operative content.
Rendering into a condition turns episodic reconciliation into a settled relation.
Mutual affection is the durable relation produced when estrangement is removed.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are an undifferentiated class rewarded with favor.
changed_reading.after: The deeds can be read as reconciliatory dealings whose divinely stabilized yield is reciprocal affection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عملوا, سيجعل, لهم, and ودا form a work-assignment-beneficiary-result chain inside the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wage branch of work and the appointed-fee branch of making jointly open a nonmonetary compensation frame in which affection itself fills the recompense slot.

activation_trace.role: Work's wage or provision supplies the remuneration frame.
An appointed fee for work supplies the act of assigning recompense.
Affection fills the assigned compensation slot instead of money.

changed_reading.before: Love is one unspecified reward among others.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse appoints affection itself as the nonmonetary recompense of reparative work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claimed future of wealth and offspring ends in solitary arrival, while the focus promise assigns affection; wudd is thereby repriced as a durable alternative to accumulated property and genealogical continuation.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the claimant's first imagined reward currency.
Offspring from one's line supplies the claimant's imagined continuity.
The isolated individual removes both possessions and lineage from the arrival scene.
The appointed recompense branch lets the focus promise answer the earlier reward claim.
Affection becomes the alternative value that the Compassionate actually assigns.

structural_cues: 19:77 projects مالا وولدا into the future; 19:80 strips the speaker to فردا; 19:96 supplies a different future object, ودا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival future goods and solitary arrival; I infer a substitution of value, while the live alternative is that the promise of wudd is not directly pricing the earlier claim.

changed_reading.before: Affection is a nonmaterial wage inferred from focus-root branches alone.
changed_reading.after: Affection reads as the deliberately nonpossessable, nongenealogical recompense set against the claimant's wealth-and-offspring economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acquired divine patrons are intended to become honor for their clients but reverse into opponents; the Compassionate's direct making of wudd supplies the contrasting relation that human patronage cannot manufacture.

activation_trace.role: Taking as acquisition supplies the attempt to manufacture a patronal relation.
Strength and honor after abasement name the social power sought from those patrons.
Contradictory opposition marks the acquired relation's reversal.
Divine rendering supplies the counter-mode of producing a social condition.
Affection replaces brittle prestige with a positively attached relation.

structural_cues: The matched beneficiary phrases ليكونوا لهم عزا and سيجعل لهم الرحمن ودا align sought honor with given affection, after the former becomes ضدا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel beneficiary constructions and the patronage reversal; I read wudd as a counter-gift to sought izz, though it may instead be an independent reward with no direct substitution.

changed_reading.before: The Compassionate generally grants love to believers.
changed_reading.after: The Compassionate grants reliable belonging as a counter-patronage to the honor people try, and fail, to acquire through substitute gods.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two gathered movements terminate differently: protected people arrive before the Compassionate as a delegation, while criminals are driven to their destination; wudd gains the concrete social shape of welcomed reception.

activation_trace.role: Gathering a group toward a destination supplies the collective movement.
Arrival before one possessing authority casts the protected group as an acknowledged delegation.
Driving and expulsion supply the coercive counter-mode of movement.
Arrival at a destination completes the parallel while preserving its harsher mode.
Merciful beneficence characterizes the authority receiving the first group.
Affection names the welcomed relation made for that collective.

structural_cues: 19:85-86 pair collective motion and terminal accusatives, إلى الرحمن وفدا versus إلى جهنم وردا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting modes of arrival; I infer that wudd names the reception fitting the delegation, while the alternative is that arrival and later affection are separate promises.

changed_reading.before: Wudd is an abstract favorable feeling.
changed_reading.after: Wudd becomes a reception-status: the protected are gathered into a welcomed delegation rather than driven as an undifferentiated mass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's boiling, hissing agitation is set against the focus ayah's heart-settling trust and made affection, yielding two opposed forms of unseen affective causation.

activation_trace.role: Boiling that emits a hiss supplies a kinetic image for incited agitation.
Security and heart-stillness supply the opposite affective state.
Rendering into a condition makes the settled state an effected outcome.
Affection is the socially shared form of that settlement.

structural_cues: 19:83 and 19:96 both depict an unseen agent producing a human affective disposition, but with opposed agents and results.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boiling agitation and secure affection; I supply the settling-versus-inciting contrast, while the alternative is to keep azz as coercive urging without a thermal or affective bridge.

changed_reading.before: Faith and affection form a positive sequence.
changed_reading.after: The sequence is also counter-agitation: secure assent is made socially contagious as affection rather than being driven into a boil.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope allows association by covenant and intercession, rejects offspring attributed to the Compassionate, and names all as servants; wudd then becomes a granted, nonprocreative mode of closeness.

activation_trace.role: A mediator joining another supplies an authorized form of association.
A preserved covenant supplies the authorization for that association.
Biological offspring supplies the relation explicitly attributed and then rejected.
Submissive service supplies the universal creaturely relation that remains.
Kinship and womb-relation in the divine title's root opens a cautious relational resonance without asserting descent.
Affection supplies the positive bond that does not require divine filiation.

structural_cues: The repeated الرحمن of 19:87-93 rejects ولد and culminates, after universal عبدا, in الرحمن making ودا at 19:96.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected descent, authorized association, servitude, and a kinship branch under ر ح م; I infer a rerouting from genealogy to affection, while the live alternative is that الرحمن carries only mercy here.

changed_reading.after: After divine offspring is denied, the same title makes a nonprocreative, covenant-compatible bond of affection among servants.

context_deltas.mechanism: A false relational claim generates cascading fracture, while reparative deeds and divinely made affection generate cohesion; wudd becomes the social opposite of a world-splitting utterance.

activation_trace.role: Opening and splitting supply the first material image of disintegration.
A group's fissure through disagreement bridges cosmic cracking to social division.
Violent breaking and demolition complete the context's disintegration sequence.
Reconciliation that removes aversion supplies the counter-process to social fissure.
Rendering into a condition supplies the constructive directional arrow.
Mutual affection supplies the cohesive social result.

structural_cues: 19:89-90 move from one relational assertion to cosmic fracture; 19:96 moves from plural reparative acts to one divinely produced relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fracture images and focus branches of reconciliation and affection; I infer a reparative answer, while the alternative is that 19:96 follows the judgment sequence without reversing its cosmic mechanics.

changed_reading.after: Righteous action is anti-fissure practice, and the Compassionate makes wudd as the cohesion opposed to divisive speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhaustive counting and solitary arrival preserve each person distinctly; the immediate shift to الذين and لهم with wudd re-associates those accounted singles as a relational plural without erasing individuality.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies complete individuation.
Counting the counted reinforces person-by-person determination.
The solitary one supplies the immediate pre-focus social condition.
Rendering into a new condition supplies re-association after individuation.
Mutual affection supplies the relation made for the restored plural.

structural_cues: 19:94-95 narrow from exhaustive plural accounting to كلهم...فردا; 19:96 immediately reopens the plural with الذين and لهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact individuation followed by plural beneficiaries; I infer relational reconstitution, while the alternative is that each individual separately receives affection from an unspecified source.

changed_reading.before: Affection is simply granted to a preexisting believer-group.
changed_reading.after: Affection is the new relational field made for fully accounted individuals after each has stood alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after wudd is promised, the message is made easy on the tongue to bring joy and confront intense contentiousness; affection becomes a speakable public disposition set against ludd rather than a hidden feeling.

activation_trace.role: Ease opening after difficulty supplies communicative accessibility.
Language and speech supply the public medium.
News that opens the face with joy supplies an affective speech-act.
Intense contentiousness supplies the opposed public disposition.
Affection supplies the public disposition whose sound and sense contrast with ludd.

structural_cues: The adjacent verse endings ودا and لدا create a tight sound contrast, while 19:97 explicitly places the second term in a tongue-and-message scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, sound contrast, eased language, joyful news, and contentiousness; I infer communicative mediation of wudd, while the alternative is that 19:97 concerns delivery only and does not cause the promised affection.

changed_reading.before: Wudd is inward affection produced without a specified medium.
changed_reading.after: Wudd is a publicly articulable and joy-bearing relation poised against ludd, with eased proclamation as a possible means of social transformation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the peg sense is a form-distant branch of و د د, not the ordinary sense of ودا. It remains anchored by that exact focus branch and by the packet's splitting and demolition sequence. Downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy, affection as a fastener, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سيجعل...ودا at words 6 and 9 can activate making or setting a peg-like fastener after the rupture imagery of 19:90.

activation_trace.role: Fissure and opening supply the material break that would require fastening.
Violent demolition raises the scale of the instability.
Making or bringing a thing about supplies the act of setting the stabilizer.
The assimilated peg sense supplies the material image of a fastener.

changed_reading.before: The Compassionate will create love for them.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the Compassionate sets affection like a fastener that holds a fissured social world together.

strongest_changes: The matched لهم constructions turn wudd into a counter-gift to the failed search for izz through acquired patrons.
The immediate move from exhaustive counting and فردا to plural beneficiaries makes affection a re-association of distinct individuals.
Rejected divine offspring redirects relational closeness away from genealogy and toward granted affection among servants.
The adjacent ودا and لدا place affection against public contentiousness and open a possible communicative mechanism.
summary.what_was_special: The trace repeatedly changes abstract love into a social mechanism: alternative value, reliable patronage, welcomed reception, post-solitary association, anti-fissure cohesion, and a speakable counter to contention.
remaining_uncertainties: The counter-gift and re-association readings are strongly sequenced but their causal arrows remain reader-supplied.
The kinship resonance of ر ح م and the wage and peg branches are activations, not claims about the ordinary lexical senses in 19:96.
19:97 may only describe delivery of the message rather than a means by which wudd is produced.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly pairs faith and righteous action with a divinely given welcome, establishing the focus condition and outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds repentance to faith and sound action as a route to flourishing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repeats the faith-and-righteous-action condition with an otherworldly reception.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Restates the core condition and its favorable divine result, though it is already represented.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate continuation frames the message as good news for the God-conscious, extending the local closing sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repeats the core condition and a final reward without clarifying affection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds an unbroken recompense for faithful righteous action, but repeats the established pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Assures that a believer's righteous effort is neither denied nor lost.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Reiterates the faithful-righteous condition and enduring reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Expands righteous action through prayer and giving, with security as its result.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Supplies a concrete confession of faith but not the righteous action or affection outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly parallels God making affection between previously hostile parties, giving the focus a social relational horizon.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Joins faith and righteous action to mawadda, making love a central relational counterpart to the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Only completes the preceding confession's identification of the Lord.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pairs return with the Merciful and Loving Lord, directly illuminating divine love alongside restored relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its false attribution involving servants of the Merciful supplies a boundary around claims made in the name of al-Rahman.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shows faith and righteous action embodied in truthful speech, remembrance, and measured response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Offers the contrary case of claimed association without faith and with futile works.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names al-Rahman but adds no relational or ethical development.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Provides only the general divine name al-Rahman.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repeats the faith-and-righteous-action formula with joy as reward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The promise of ease after hardship shares the making verb but not the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repeats the faith-and-righteous-action formula and enduring garden outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.note: The secure city image does not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P5 (19:77-98) - Speech Meeting Affection or Resistance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A delivered message reveals its hearers by the movement it elicits, easy reception and affection or lateral resistance and dispute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ease becomes compliant gait and downward twist, contention becomes side-to-side dosing and blockage, and divine affection reverses the name of an idol.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Affection and the reversal of Wadd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Affection is assigned to faithful action, while the same lexical field remembers an idol whose name promised a counterfeit attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mutual love and attachment (`quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`); desire for a wished outcome (`quranic:root_001634:B002/m01`); Wadd as an idol-name (`quranic:root_001634:B005/m01`); trusting assent (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); sound and reparative action (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`); appointing a new state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 19:96 (ء م ن, ع م ل, ص ل ح, ج ع ل, ر ح م, و د د)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The love granted to faithful action is sharpened by the same root's idol-name. Attachment is no longer projected onto an acquired deity; it is made as the social outcome of trust and reparative conduct.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nefis, aile veya kalp genisligi ve sakin mizac alaninda durur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi kisinin ic dunyasinda guven ve rahatlik tasvir edebilir.

İyi duruma getirme, iyi yaratma, var olan bozukluğu giderme veya bir kimsenin iyi olduğuna hükmetme yollarıyla gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Bir başkasının durumu karşısında yüreğin yumuşaması, ona acıma ve içten yakınlık duyma çekirdeği oluşturur.

Dal bölünmeden korunabilir, fakat tanım yalnızca doğum sonrası ağrıyla sınırlandırılmamalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Dişi deve, koyun veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanmasıyla; koyunda ise ayrıca şişmesiyle belirlenen durumdur. Bazı kullanımlar bunu doğum sonrasına bağlar. Koyunun doğumdan sonra yavru zarını atamaması da bu organ çevresindeki özel bir bozukluk olarak dala dahildir.

facets.statement: Dişi hayvan veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanması temel durumdur; özellikle bazı kullanımlarda bu durum doğum sonrasında görülür.
Koyunun doğum yaptıktan sonra yavru zarını dışarı atamaması, dala bağlı özel bir doğum sonrası bozukluktur.
Koyun veya koyun sürüsünde döl yatağının şişmesi, hastalık durumunun özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, dişi deve, koyun veya kadının döl yatağında ağrı ya da hastalık bulunmasını temel alır. Kaynakların bir bölümü bunu özellikle doğum sonrasına bağlar. Toplu anlatım ayrıca koyunda organın şişmesini ve doğumdan sonra yavru zarının atılamamasını aynı organ çevresindeki özel durumlar olarak kaydeder.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın somut merkezinde yere çakılan ya da bir şeyi tutan kazık nesnesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Nesne düzeyinde çekirdek aynıdır; ancak bu dal yalnızca bölgesel kaynaşmış biçimdir. Komşu dal olağan adı, eylemi ve daha geniş bağlı kullanımları da içerdiği için sınırlar tam eşleşmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kazık nesnesini başına nasıl vurulduğuna bakmadan genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Darbelerle başı örselenen özel bir kazık türünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da üzerine vurulabilen somut bir kazık nesnesine gönderme yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın kazık anlamında darbe sonucu oluşan bir özellik şart değildir. Komşu ise başına vurulup örselenmiş kazığı özel olarak adlandırdığı için daha dar bir sınır taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel kazık dalı ve darbeyle özelleşen kazık dalı doğrudan sınır karşılaştırması sağlar. Öteki adaylar farklı destek araçları, direkler, yerleştirme eylemleri veya aynı yazılıştaki ilgisiz anlamlardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الود بمعنى الوتد في لغة تميم أو أهل نجد، على أنه لفظ مدغم أو مقلوب ذكرته المصادر داخل هذا الباب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الوداد والمودة ولا الصنم ولا أسماء المواضع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: فأما الود فالوتد (maqayis)؛ الود لغة تميمية وهو الوتد (jamhara)؛ الود بالفتح الوتد في لغة أهل نجد كأنهم سكنوا التاء فأدغموها في الدال (sihah)؛ الود بلغة تميم الوتد (tahdhib)؛ الود: الوتد، وأصله يصح أن يكون وتد فأدغم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı köke bağlı iki biçimi, bilinen bir dağın ve bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olarak verir. Dalın birleştirici sınırı ortak bir yer türü değil, bu biçimlerin yer adı olarak kullanılmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca dağ ve vadiye gönderme yapan özel ad kullanımlarını kapsar; coğrafi yerlerin genel adlarını veya başka özel adları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak biçimlerin yer adı işleviyle sınırlıdır ve aynı yazılışın sevgi, dilek, kazık ya da put anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir çıplak biçimin bilinen bir dağın, aynı köke bağlı başka bir çıplak biçimin ise bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olarak kullanılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çıplak biçimin bilinen bir dağın özel adı olarak kullanılması.
Aynı köke bağlı başka bir çıplak biçimin bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak aktarımının ortak merkezi bilinen bir dağa verilen özel addır; aynı köke bağlı başka bir biçim ayrıca bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olarak kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki çıplak biçimin sırasıyla belirli bir dağ ve belirli bir vadi için özel ad oluşunu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yer türlerini ve bunların özel ad olarak kullanılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İlk çıplak biçimin belirli bir dağa gönderme yaptığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin dağ oluşunu ve biçimin özel ad işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İkinci çıplak biçimin belirli bir vadiye gönderme yaptığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin vadi oluşunu ve biçimin özel ad işlevini korur.
İlk göndergenin bir dağ olduğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Biçimin belirli bir yerin özel adı oluşunu ve vadi kullanımını yitirir.
error_profile.adds: Herhangi bir dağı bildiren genel ad kapsamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Özel adı yer türünün genel adıyla karıştırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; diğer yer adı dalları yalnızca özel ad olma alanını paylaşır ve farklı göndergelere sahiptir. Aynı kökün sevgi, dilek ve put adı dalları da yazılış dışında anlam sınırını aydınlatacak bir ortaklık sunmaz.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الود اسما لجبل معروف وودان اسما لواد معروف كما ورد في المادة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المحبة أو التمني أو الصنم أو الوتد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الود: جبل معروف؛ وودان: واد معروف (jamhara)؛ هو اسم جبل (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi biçimi, tapınılan belirli bir putun özel adı olarak açıklar; toplu aktarım bu adı farklı eski topluluklarla ilişkilendirir ve ondan türetilmiş bir kişi adını da kaydeder. Kişi adı, put adı çekirdeğine bağlı bir adlandırmadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli putlara verilmiş özel adı ve bu addan türeyen kişi adını kapsar; putların genel adını veya başka put adlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak biçimdeki put adını çekirdek tutar ve bu addan kurulan kişi adını bağımlı bir kullanım olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Biçimin, farklı eski toplulukların tapındığı belirli bir puta verilen özel ad olarak kullanılmasıdır. Bu put adından kurulan kişi adı, çekirdeğe bağlı ayrı bir adlandırmadır.

facets.statement: Biçimin tapınılan belirli bir puta verilen özel ad olarak kullanılması.
Aynı özel adın toplu aktarımda farklı eski toplulukların putlarıyla ilişkilendirilmesi.
Putun özel adından bir kişi adı kurulması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar biçimin bir putun özel adı olduğu konusunda birleşir. Toplu aktarım bu adı farklı eski topluluklarla ilişkilendirir ve ayrıca put adından kurulmuş bir kişi adını kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Biçimin tapınılan belirli bir puta verilen özel ad olduğu çekirdek kullanımını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin put oluşunu ve biçimin özel ad işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli putun kimliğinin adın yüzey biçimi verilmeden açıklanması gereken bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınılan belirli put göndergesini ve adlandırma işlevini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin tapınılan bir put olduğunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel put adı ile genel kötü güç adı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da Tanrı dışında tapınılan bir varlığa gönderme yapabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir putun özel adıdır. Komşu dal ise putla sınırlı olmayan, kötü yola sürükleyen veya tapınılan çeşitli varlıkları kapsayan genel bir sınıf adı olduğundan olağan kullanımda yerine geçemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayrı bir puta verilen özel adı ve ondan kurulan kişi adını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal başka bir puta verilmiş ayrı bir özel addır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da eski toplulukların taptığı putlara verilmiş özel adlardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortaklık yalnızca aynı adlandırma alanında bulunmalarıdır. Göndergeleri farklı putlar olduğu için adlar birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz ve anlam çekirdekleri özdeş sayılmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir putun özel adını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Oyulmuş veya işlenmiş insan biçimli nesneyi, resmi ve bunlara benzetilen varlıkları genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insan biçimi verilmiş ve put olarak kullanılabilen bir nesneye gönderme yapabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın belirleyici özelliği belirli bir putun özel adı olmasıdır. Komşu dal nesnenin işlenmiş görüntü veya yontu oluşunu anlatan daha geniş bir ortak ad alanına sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan karşılaştırmalar özel put adını genel tapınma sınıfından, başka bir put adından ve yontu ortak adından ayırır. Kalan adaylar başka put adları, tapınmayla ilişkili eylem ve nesneler veya aynı yazılışın ilgisiz dallarıdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ود أو ودا اسما لصنم، وخاصة الصنم المذكور لقوم نوح أو لقبائل العرب، وما ربطته المصادر بالتسمية بعبد ود.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المودة العامة ولا التمني ولا الوتد ولا الموضع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وود: صنم هكذا فسر في التنزيل؛ وقد قالوا ود أيضا (jamhara)؛ وود: صنم كان لقوم نوح ثم صار لكلاب (sihah)؛ الود صنم كان لقوم نوح، وكان لقريش صنم يدعونه ودا؛ ومنه سمي عبد ود (tahdhib)؛ الود: صنم سمي بذلك (mufradat)
